instruments_due.title: Cheques and traites due
instruments_due.hint: Cheques and traites falling due within a week, or already past their day, that are still held or deposited. Deposit them, then cash them.

late_customer.title: Customers late paying
late_customer.hint: Customers with invoices past due for longer than the threshold. Chase them.

unsold_products.title: Products not selling
unsold_products.hint: Active goods that have not been sold for longer than the threshold.

reorder_point.title: To reorder
reorder_point.hint: Products whose stock is at its reorder point, or under it.

running_out.title: Running out soon
running_out.hint: Products whose stock, at the pace of the last 30 days, lasts fewer days than it takes to restock.

lot_expired.title: Expired lots
lot_expired.hint: Lots still in stock whose expiry date has passed.

lot_expiring.title: Lots expiring soon
lot_expiring.hint: Lots in stock whose expiry date is close: sell them first.

receipt_cost_to_complete.title: Receipt costs to complete
receipt_cost_to_complete.hint: Receipts recorded by someone who cannot see costs: their cost is still to be entered.

invitation_unsent.title: Invitations not sent
invitation_unsent.hint: Invitations whose mail did not go out, even after several tries: the person received no link. Invite them again from Members.

amount_to_check.title: Amounts to check
amount_to_check.hint: Drafts prepared by a recurring expense of variable amount. Check each amount against the bill, then record the expense.

margin_moved.title: Margins to review
margin_moved.hint: A receipt changed the cost price under a selling price that stayed the same: adjust the price or keep it.

to_check.title: Products to check
to_check.hint: A product marked « To check », or lacking what a product needs here: complete its page.

to_check.title: Vendors to check
to_check.hint: A vendor marked « To check », or whose name a file was unsure of: look at its page again.

to_check.title: Customers to check
to_check.hint: A customer marked « To check », or a business without the number an invoice asks of it: complete its page.
